title: A newborn lamb snuggles up to a boy
excerpt: to find someone who appears to be a tad bit more chaotic than me
body:
to find someone who appears to be
a tad bit more chaotic than me
when we lie together it reminds me of a photograph
a newly-born lamb snuggles up to a boy
lying on wet grass
sleepy smile as face touches flesh
the ultimate understanding
peace at last
